capabilities: Start a dated test run from a checklist note
Record a result and evidence for each check
Link vault files such as screenshots as evidence
Compare a run with the previous run or the last run in the same environment
Track items through wording changes with block IDs
disambiguation: Not a release or publishing tool; it records manual test results taken from Markdown checklists.
extras: Installation is described as manual only (copy the plugin folder into .obsidian/plugins). The plugin works on local Markdown and does not contact a server; MIT licensed.
problem: Markdown checklists show what to verify but not the outcome of each pass, so repeated release checks leave no record to compare against.
summary: Turns a Markdown checklist into a dated test-run note with per-item results, evidence links, and comparison to a previous run.
